source_note: Updated from user-confirmed game info after web search did not return reliable exact chest pages. Treat these as current manual truth until a screenshot/cost table overrides them.

legend_collectible_and_resonance_chip_ch.optimizer_use: Compare tech progress vs legend collectible set bonus vs resonance chip breakpoint. Do not categorize this as only collectible or only resonance.

relic_core_chest.optimizer_use: Compare immediate SS forge need vs S-grade equipment fodder need.

s_grade_excellent_choice_pack.optimizer_use: Use only when the exact S equipment family/slot helps a confirmed forge or build target.

voidwalker_supply_crate.gives: one selectable Voidwaker S-grade equipment item
voidwalker_supply_crate.optimizer_use: Use only for confirmed Voidwaker equipment or fodder need.
